zh.title: SMELT 的核心做法：将中间 50% 的层执行两次，同时匹配计算量、参数量和 KV cache。

en.title: The core of SMELT: run the middle 50% of layers twice while matching compute, parameters, and KV cache.

zh.title: 循环中间约 50% 的层时验证损失最低。

en.title: Validation loss is lowest when roughly the middle 50% of layers are looped.

zh.title: Looped Transformer 的最优执行深宽比高于基线。

en.title: Looped Transformers have a larger optimal effective depth-to-width ratio than the Baseline.

zh.title: 循环两次效果最好；三次和四次不如两次（我们归因于模型被迫变窄），但仍优于基线。

en.title: Looping twice works best; three or four loops trail two (we attribute this to the narrower model that matching requires) but still beat the Baseline.

zh.title: 在所有模型规模和稀疏度下，SMELT 都能以相近计算量获得更低的验证损失。

en.title: At every model scale and sparsity level, SMELT reaches lower validation loss at comparable compute.

zh.title: 分别拟合基线和 SMELT 得到的 Scaling Law 系数。

en.title: Scaling-law coefficients fitted separately for the Baseline and SMELT.

zh.title: 从 10²⁰ FLOPs 起，SMELT 的计算最优前沿更低；在 S ≈ 97%、10²¹ FLOPs 时可节省 14.7% 的训练计算量。

en.title: From 10²⁰ FLOPs onward, SMELT’s compute-optimal frontier is lower; at S ≈ 97% and 10²¹ FLOPs, it saves 14.7% of training compute.

zh.title: SMELT 在 96 组匹配对中的 83 组上取得更高的 DCLM Core 分数。

en.title: SMELT scores higher on DCLM Core in 83 of 96 matched pairs.

zh.title: 在基线明显高于随机水平的 30 组匹配对中，SMELT 在 29 组上取得更高的 MMLU 准确率。

en.title: Among the 30 matched pairs whose Baseline scores clearly above chance, SMELT has higher MMLU accuracy in 29.

zh.title: 即使验证损失相同，SMELT 在三项下游指标上的平均表现也都高于基线预测；相对这条合并拟合的基线曲线，这一额外收益大体随模型规模增大。

en.title: Even at the same validation loss, SMELT on average beats the Baseline curve on all three downstream metrics; measured against this pooled curve, the extra gain broadly grows with model scale.

zh.title: SMELT 在所有数据领域上都有收益，其中代码数据收益最大。

en.title: SMELT gains in every data domain, and the gain is largest on Code.

zh.title: 长文本上 SMELT 相对基线的收益更明显：按各匹配对归一化后，约为短文本的 1.5 倍。

en.title: SMELT’s gain over the Baseline is larger on long texts: after normalizing each matched pair, about 1.5× its gain on short ones.

zh.title: 给出 in-context 示例后，SMELT 的优势明显扩大；在 Dyck Languages 上，差距从 8 个示例起逐渐拉开。

en.title: Once in-context examples are given, SMELT’s advantage widens markedly; on Dyck Languages, the gap opens up from 8 examples on.

zh.title: 第二次执行会复用部分专家，同时选择一些新专家；实际重叠远高于随机水平。

en.title: The second visit reuses some experts and selects some new ones; the overlap is far above chance.

zh.title: 第二次执行向残差流写入的更新整体更大。

en.title: The second visit writes larger updates to the residual stream overall.

zh.title: 两次执行通常看向相似的位置，但读取和写回的内容发生了更大变化。

en.title: The two visits usually attend to similar positions, but what they read and write back changes more.

zh.title: 在 Dyck 任务中，第二次执行把注意力从 BOS 转移到示例答案。

en.title: On the Dyck task, the second visit shifts attention from BOS to the answers in the examples.

zh.title: 普通模型的 attention sink 随深度增强，而 SMELT 的第二次执行会减弱 attention sink。

en.title: In the unlooped Baseline, the attention sink grows stronger with depth; SMELT’s second visit weakens it.
